items.question: How long does a course take?
items.answer: Most learners complete a course in 6–10 weeks, depending on how many lessons per week you book. There's no fixed deadline — you move at your own pace.

items.question: Do I need a learner's permit before starting?
items.answer: No — we guide new learners through applying for a learner's permit as part of the course.

items.question: How long is each practical lesson?
items.answer: Practical lessons on the Code B course are 30 minutes each day. Check each course on the [Courses page](services.html) for exactly what's included.

items.question: Do you offer evening lessons?
items.answer: Yes. Our Karonga and Mzuzu branches offer 17:30–18:30 lessons on weekdays for learners who work during the day.

items.question: Can I switch instructors if it's not a good fit?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely. Just let our office know and we'll pair you with another instructor at no extra cost.

items.question: What happens if I fail my official test?
items.answer: Standard course students get one free re-test preparation lesson. We'll also help you rebook your test date.

items.question: How can I prepare for the theory test at home?
items.answer: Try our free [practice theory test](theory-test.html) — it gives you instant feedback and explains every answer.

items.question: Where are your branches?
items.answer: We have branches in Mzuzu and Karonga. See the [Contact page](contact.html) for addresses, phone numbers, opening hours and directions.
